career_ladder.note: Judicial officers in Himachal Pradesh are governed by the Himachal Pradesh Judicial Service Rules and the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix as mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. Progression includes Assured Career Progression (ACP) scale elevations at 5-year intervals and merit-cum-seniority cadre promotions up to the High Court of Himachal Pradesh.

exam_scheme.note: The Himachal Pradesh Judicial Service Competitive Examination is conducted in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening test consisting of three papers conducted on the same day), Main Examination (Written narrative / subjective papers), and Viva-Voce (Personality Test).

stages.source_label: HPPSC Judicial Service Examination Scheme & Syllabus

financial_package.note: Judicial officers in Himachal Pradesh receive compensation based on the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix as mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. Entry pay scale Level J-1 is ₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520 with judicial perks and allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: HPPSC Advt. No. 31/12-2024 & SNJPC Pay Matrix in WP(C) 643/2015
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated from SNJPC Level J-1 entry basic ₹77,840 + 58% DA (₹45,147) + judicial HRA (8%–16% or government residential bungalow) + judicial sumptuary, robe, medical, conveyance, hill compensatory/winter allowance, and domestic orderly allowances. In-hand estimate accounts for 10% NPS deduction, GIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Official designated judicial residence / government bungalow in posting district or court complex
Sumptuary allowance and robe allowance per SNJPC recommendations
Official vehicle / conveyance allowance with driver and monthly fuel entitlement
Comprehensive medical treatment facilities and reimbursement for officer and family members
Electricity and water consumption charge reimbursement up to prescribed monthly limits
Residential orderly / home peon allowance and telephone/broadband reimbursement
